correctness.rationale: A reflection block decomposition reduces the cycle to two cyclic Jacobi matrices. Their cross-spectrum resultant factors into r common-eigenvalue terms linear in (w-1) and the antisymmetric determinant 1+(n-1)w. The path at w=0 fixes the global sign. The rank at w=1 follows from Fourier eigenspace projections, and singular-value Weyl bounds combined with exact determinant order yield the two-sided small-defect singular-value rate. Exact symbolic and rational checker gives 144 corroborating assertions; it is not substituted for the unbounded proof. Real signed boundary and positive conductance cases are separated.

value.rationale: The exact polynomial gives a finite-dimensional all-order quantitative controllability-volume law for one-edge symmetry breaking on a natural ring. Its roots distinguish a symmetry-driven rank failure from the signed-Laplacian semidefiniteness boundary, and its root multiplicity controls how rapidly the least Krylov singular value collapses near symmetry. This resolves a motivated sensitivity/actuator configuration rather than an arbitrary small graph census. No continuous-time energy claim or general actuator-site classification is made.
